promulgated-standing-laws.reason: Governing by published general laws applied by independent courts is one of the most important safeguards against arbitrary power.

racial-franchise.reason: Limiting the vote and office to one racial or ethnic group is a plain denial of equal citizenship.

online-participation.reason: Online deliberation can widen participation, but it also invites manipulation and polarisation, so I am torn.

open-government-data.reason: Publishing decision records and how proposals were handled makes government accountable and checkable.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.reason: Adults should be free to marry across religious lines, and the state should not restrict it.

boycott-minority-shops.reason: Deliberately shunning shops because of their owners' religion is discrimination.

citizens-assembly.reason: Randomly chosen citizens deliberating on hard questions can produce thoughtful results, though they need expert support and clear limits.

reinterpret-religion.reason: Religious traditions have always reinterpreted doctrine, but whether and how to do so is for believers to decide, so I am torn.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.reason: Extreme concentrations of money can translate into political influence, so limiting them helps protect equal liberty.

open-lgbt-military-service.reason: Sexual orientation has no bearing on ability to serve, so gay and lesbian people should serve openly.

state-promotes-atheism.reason: A state should stay neutral on belief, so promoting unbelief through public schools is a mistake.

abolish-police-prisons.reason: Some form of policing and prisons is needed to protect people, though they should be far more humane and reformed.

power-sharing-divided-societies.reason: Guaranteed power-sharing can keep deeply divided societies peaceful, but it can also entrench divisions, so I am torn.

charity-over-state-aid.reason: Local charities and communities add real value, but large public programs are needed for reliable coverage, so I am torn.

term-limits.reason: Term limits bring turnover, but they also cost voters a choice and lose experience, so I am torn.

vote-delegation.reason: Revocable delegation is an interesting idea, but it adds complexity and concentrates influence in intermediaries, so I am torn.

existential-risk-priority.reason: Catastrophic risks deserve serious attention, though they should be weighed against pressing present harms.

women-in-religious-leadership.reason: Women's equal eligibility for religious office is a fair principle, even though religious communities should decide their own practice.

shared-marital-authority.reason: Spouses are equal partners, so authority within a marriage should be shared rather than held by one.

foreign-residents-local-vote.reason: Long-term residents who live under local rules can reasonably have a voice in local elections.

rent-control.reason: Caps can protect tenants in shortages but can also reduce supply and upkeep, so the evidence leaves me torn.

abolish-ip.reason: Some legal protection for inventors and creators helps fund new work, though the current term lengths are often too long.

uniformed-youth.reason: Young people's associations should be free and voluntary rather than drilled for national ends.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.reason: The arguments against hosting nuclear weapons are strong, but so are the security arguments for them, so I am torn.

no-foreign-bases.reason: Sovereignty matters, but allied bases can also bring real security, so the answer depends on the specific case.

recognise-genocide.reason: Officially acknowledging genocide is part of honest historical accountability, though labels are best left to careful scholarship.

income-for-work-not-ownership.reason: Pay for work matters, but returns on capital and property are also a legitimate part of a market economy, so I am torn.

never-kill-self-defence.reason: Lethal force is sometimes the only way to stop a deadly attack, so an absolute prohibition seems too strong.

unbroken-national-continuity.reason: Nations change a great deal over time, so claiming an unbroken identity from antiquity overstates continuity.

sex-socially-constructed.reason: Sex is a biological fact, while gender roles and categories are where culture and language do most of their shaping.

no-fixed-category-of-women.reason: Women differ widely, but a shared interest in equality still gives feminist politics a common ground, so I am torn.

martyrs-honoured.reason: Honouring the national dead is reasonable, but calling them saints turns civic remembrance into something sacred.

politics-spiritual-struggle.reason: Politics is mainly about interests, institutions and compromise, not a cosmic battle between good and evil.

homeland-cultural-centre.reason: A homeland can inspire a diaspora without holding everyone, but the right balance depends on circumstances, so I am torn.

culture-before-state.reason: Cultures and states shape each other, so making cultural renewal wait for statehood seems the wrong order.

god-not-male.reason: Religious language is a matter for believers and their traditions, so I decline to weigh in strongly.

scripture-judged-by-women.reason: Judging teachings by their effect on women's dignity is a serious moral test, but applying it to scripture is for believers, so I am torn.

economy-in-majority-hands.reason: Economic life should be open to everyone regardless of group, so reserving it for the majority is discrimination.

single-unit-for-people.reason: Giving a people its own region can be just, but borders that follow ethnicity can also create new minorities, so I am torn.

independent-unions.reason: Unions do their job best when they answer to their members rather than to the state or a party.

socialism-needs-workers-power.reason: Real worker power is central to what socialism promises, so state ownership alone seems not enough.

local-essentials-public.reason: Water, hospitals and local transport are essentials that public ownership can protect, though contracting can work well too.

second-chamber.reason: A second chamber adds checks but also delay and cost, so reasonable systems differ and I am torn.

municipal-property.reason: Local ownership of productive assets has real appeal, but private and state ownership each have strengths, so I am torn.

confederal-coordination.reason: Local assemblies with coordinating councils is an appealing design, but binding joint decisions are often needed, so I am torn.

family-wage.reason: Pay that can support a household is a fair goal for work, though pay should also track the value of the job.

ageing-research-funding.reason: Research into healthy ageing is valuable, though it should be weighed against other health priorities.

anonymous-payments.reason: Financial privacy protects people, but it also helps crime and evades law, so I am torn.

online-anonymity.reason: Pseudonymity protects people from harassment and surveillance, though accountability for abuse still matters.

person-over-state.reason: Individuals have a dignity that the state and community may not override for their own ends.
